name: Power Word Heal
summary: Restores all of a creature's Hit Points and ends several conditions on it.

stats.effect: A wave of healing energy washes over one creature you can see within range. The target regains all its {ref:glossary/hit-points}. If the creature has the {ref:condition/charmed}, {ref:condition/frightened}, {ref:condition/paralyzed}, {ref:condition/poisoned}, or {ref:condition/stunned} condition, the condition ends. If the creature has the {ref:condition/prone} condition, it can use its {ref:glossary/reaction} to stand up.
